treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Kenya and the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and capital (1972)
source_title: Kenya Subsidiary Legislation 1973 — Kenya–Denmark Convention (scanned, Kenya Treasury)

rates.article: Article 10(2)(a) as modified by MLI art. 8(1)
rates.quote: 2. However, such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that State; if they are so taxed the tax charged in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividend is a resident shall not exceed: (a) 20 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the recipient is a company which owns at least 25 per cent of the voting shares of the company paying the dividends during the period of six months immediately preceding the date of payment of the dividends;
(b) 30 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State; if it is so taxed the tax charged in the Contracting State in which the interest arises shall not exceed 20 per cent of the gross amount of that interest.

2. However, such royalties may be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State; if they are so taxed the tax charged in the Contracting State in which the royalties arise shall not exceed 20 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Effect: Art. 31(1)(a) 'in respect of income arising for the year of income 1972 and subsequent years'. MLI: covered by both (KE no.2, DK no.27); MLI WHT effect 2026-01-01 (map). Art. 8: Kenya notified Art. 10(2)(a) and Denmark notified Art. 10(2) for Kenya, so MLI art. 8(1) applies: the 25% holding must be met throughout a 365-day period including the payment date, replacing the treaty's six-month period (before 2026-01-01 the 20% tier required 6 months, ~183 days). Art. 7: Kenya chose the Simplified LOB and Denmark chose Art. 7(7)(a), so the SLOB applies in addition to the PPT. Interest: Art. 11(3) exempts interest paid to the other Government, local authority, Central Bank or wholly owned agency (incl. the Industrialisation Fund for Developing Countries of Denmark) — not modelled. The 30% general dividend cap exceeds Kenya's domestic rate; included as the treaty cap.
